title: Resource Economics for Understanding Recreational Fishers and Fisheries
abstract: We describe how resource economics measures the economic benefit of recreational fishing. Information about economic benefits provides one way to evaluate the social and economic consequences of a management or policy action. We divide this chapter into two parts. First, we describe random utility maximization theory, which explains fishing choices as a function of fishing site attributes, recreational fishers’ characteristics, and individual preferences. Models developed from random utility maximization theory and individual data have become the dominant approach in fisheries valuation. We emphasize that this value, though nearly always denominated in money units, is not equivalent to the actual amount of money spent on fishing. Second, we provide a pair of empirical demonstrations, one using actual fishing trip data and another using hypothetical data, based on a mail survey of license holders. We end this chapter with a discussion of using economic models to predict behaviours, frontier areas in recreation demand modelling, and integration with interdisciplinary research.
abstract_zh: 我们描述了资源经济学如何衡量休闲垂钓的经济效益。关于经济效益的信息，为评估管理或政策行动的社会和经济后果提供了一种途径。本章分为两部分。首先，我们介绍随机效用最大化理论，该理论将垂钓选择解释为垂钓地点属性、休闲垂钓者特征以及个人偏好的函数。基于随机效用最大化理论和个体数据构建的模型，已成为渔业价值评估中的主流方法。我们强调，这一价值虽然几乎总是以货币单位表示，但并不等同于垂钓者实际花费的金额。其次，我们提供了两个实证示范：一个使用实际垂钓出行数据，另一个基于对执照持有人的邮寄问卷调查所获得的假设性数据。本章最后讨论了利用经济模型预测行为、休闲需求建模的前沿领域，以及与跨学科研究的整合。

title: Risky (Natural) Assets: Stochasticity, Nonconvexity, and the Value of Natural Capital
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists

title: Job Impacts of the United States Endangered Species Act
Money Can't Buy Me Fish: Lessons from an Incentivized Harvest Program
Contract and Sustain: Evaluating the Results of Progressive Implementation of Limited Entry and Catch Shares in West Coast and Alaska Fisheries Over Four Decades
venue: Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences
abstract: Access to West Coast and Alaskan fisheries has been progressively tightened for more than four decades with limited license programs, buybacks, and catch share programs. We document the implementation of a series of limited access and catch share programs in federally and state managed fisheries of the West Coast and Alaska, and evaluate trends in participation, diversification, vessel revenue, and variation of revenue between 1981 and 2022 for this large interconnected system of fisheries. Over time, progressive tightening through further input controls, buybacks, and catch shares led to substantial consolidation and greater specialization coinciding with increased temporal diversification, maintained or increased revenue per vessel, and reduced variation in inter-annual revenue. However, low levels of fishery diversification for many fishers, and high dependency on a few key fisheries, may have left fishers vulnerable to ecological and economic shocks that impacted key fisheries leading to increased income variation and further declines in participation in recent years.
abstract_zh: 四十多年来，美国西海岸和阿拉斯加渔业的准入限制不断收紧，实施了有限许可证制度、回购计划和渔获份额制度。我们记录了西海岸和阿拉斯加联邦及州管理渔业中一系列有限准入和渔获份额计划的实施情况，并对1981至2022年间这一庞大且相互关联的渔业体系中的参与度、多元化程度、船只收入以及收入波动进行了评估。随着时间推移，通过进一步的投入控制、回购和渔获份额制度的逐步收紧，渔业出现了大规模整合和更高程度的专业化，同时伴随时间多元化程度的提高、每艘船收入的维持或增长，以及年际收入波动的减小。然而，许多渔民的渔业多元化水平较低，且对少数关键渔业高度依赖，这可能使渔民在面临生态和经济冲击时较为脆弱，从而导致关键渔业受到冲击，收入波动加剧，并使近年来参与人数进一步下降。

title: Ex-ante Diversification, Limited Entry Permit Portfolios, and Fishers' Participation Decisions
abstract: This paper uses the limited entry (LE) permit portfolio in the previous year to construct an ex-ante measure of diversification at the individual level. We first show that LE permit portfolios in the previous year can effectively be seen as a choice set of the vessel this year. We then show that our diversification measure—the number of types of LE permits in the portfolio in the previous year—is strongly correlated with popular ex-post measures of diversification, but they tend to deviate when an external shock hits the fisheries. Focusing on the US West Coast during 1995–2016, we find that ex-ante more diversified vessels are more likely to participate in the following year, and they exhibit a smaller coefficient of variation in gross revenue. Overall, our measure of diversification is conceptually sound and can be used as an alternative to popular ex-post measures.
abstract_zh: 本文利用上一年度的有限准入（LE）许可证组合，构建了个体层面的事前多元化指标。我们首先表明，上一年度的LE许可证组合可以有效地被视为本年度船只的选择集。随后我们证明，我们的多元化指标——即上一年度组合中LE许可证的种类数——与常用的事后多元化指标高度相关，但在外部冲击影响渔业时两者会出现偏离。以1995至2016年美国西海岸为研究对象，我们发现，事前多元化程度更高的船只更有可能在次年继续参与捕捞，且其总收入的变异系数更小。总体而言，我们的多元化指标在概念上是合理的，可以作为常用事后指标的替代选择。

title: The Global Seafood Trade, Embodied Nutrients, and Nutritional Affordability
Not by Fishing Alone: Non-Fishing Employment and Income for US West Coast Fishers
abstract: Income diversification is an important aspect of financial security among individual fishers, who generally face high annual fluctuations in their income levels. While prior studies have analyzed the importance of diversifying within-fisheries income streams (e.g., across species groups, or region), the role of income from non-fishing occupations as an additional source of diversification has received little empirical attention. We link fisheries landing data to survey responses among 1,230 individual fishers living in the Continental US West Coast to analyze trends and correlates of individual fishers choosing to earn non-fishing income. We find that predictors capturing the opportunity cost of not fishing, pecuniary factors, and within-fishery diversity metrics significantly influence the probability that fishers earn non-fishing income. Our results indicate an overall tradeoff between within-fishery with non-fishery income diversification choices; but that this tradeoff may be weaker for particular non-fishing occupation types and at particular times of the year.
abstract_zh: 收入多元化是个体渔民经济保障的重要方面，而渔民的年收入水平通常波动很大。尽管已有研究分析了渔业内部收入来源多元化（如跨鱼种类群或跨区域）的重要性，但非渔业职业收入作为额外多元化来源的作用却很少得到实证关注。我们将渔业登陆数据与1230名居住在美国大陆西海岸的个体渔民的问卷调查结果相匹配，以分析个体渔民选择获取非渔业收入的趋势及其相关因素。我们发现，衡量不捕鱼机会成本的预测变量、金钱因素以及渔业内部多样性指标，都显著影响渔民获取非渔业收入的概率。我们的结果表明，渔业内部收入多元化与渔业外收入多元化之间总体上存在权衡；但对于某些特定的非渔业职业类型以及一年中的特定时段，这种权衡可能较弱。

title: Species, space, and time: a quarter-century of fishers' diversification strategies on the US West Coast
abstract: Diversification within fisheries operations can serve as an important form of self‐insurance against natural, regulatory and market risks to fishers' livelihoods. Diversification can take many forms, and yet the literature has primarily emphasised diversification across species to the exclusion of spatial and temporal dimensions of diversification. We analyse trends in diversification across species, space and time for all fishers along the entire continental West Coast of the United States from 1990 to 2015. Our findings reveal the importance of untangling both compositional (i.e. driven by changes in fleet composition) and individual (i.e. driven by within‐owner changes in diversification strategies) dimensions of diversification by showing how these effects have moved in contrary directions for all three forms of diversification. We also demonstrate how increases in temporal diversification have overwhelmed the overall stability of species and spatial diversification to leave the current fleet less exposed to financial variability compared to in the early 1990s.
abstract_zh: 渔业作业内部的多元化可以作为一种重要的自我保险形式，以应对自然、监管和市场风险对渔民生计的影响。多元化可以采取多种形式，然而文献主要强调跨鱼种的多元化，而忽视了多元化的空间和时间维度。我们分析了1990至2015年间美国整个大陆西海岸所有渔民在鱼种、空间和时间三个维度上的多元化趋势。研究结果表明，有必要区分构成性（即由船队构成变化驱动）和个体性（即由船东内部多元化策略变化驱动）两个维度，因为这两种效应在上述三种多元化形式上呈现出相反的变化方向。我们还表明，时间多元化的提高已超过鱼种多元化和空间多元化总体稳定性的作用，使得当前船队相较于20世纪90年代初更不易受到经济波动的影响。

title: When is Green Nudging Ethically Permissible?
`A la carte' management of recreational resources: Evidence from the US Gulf of Mexico
Adoption of 100% Renewable Energy Commitments in US Cities: The Role of Institutions and Prior Sustainability Actions
Community-level fishery measures and individual fishers: comparing primary and secondary data for the U.S. West Coast
Developing a socio-psychological model explaining farmers' income diversification in response to groundwater scarcity in Iran
venue: International Journal of Water Resources Development
abstract: Income diversification is an essential livelihood strategy for farmers facing unsustainable groundwater withdrawals. This paper develops a general structural equation model that analyses socio-psychological factors that affect the intentions to adopt and the actual adoption of income diversification in response to groundwater scarcity. The developed model includes affective attitudes, instrumental attitudes and self-efficacy. This model explains 55% and 36% of the variance in intentions to pursue and the actual pursuit of income diversification among farmers in the Rafsanjan Plain, Iran, respectively. These results can inform policies for promoting income diversification, and have implications for sustaining farmers’ livelihoods and groundwater resources.
abstract_zh: 对于面临不可持续地下水抽取的农民而言，收入多元化是一项至关重要的生计策略。本文构建了一个通用结构方程模型，分析影响农民为应对地下水短缺而采纳收入多元化意愿及实际采纳行为的社会心理因素。该模型包含情感态度、工具性态度和自我效能感。该模型分别解释了伊朗拉夫桑平原农民追求收入多元化意愿变异的55%，以及实际追求收入多元化行为变异的36%。这些结果可为促进收入多元化的政策提供参考，并对维持农民生计和地下水资源具有启示意义。

title: Structural Behavioral Models for Rights-Based Fisheries
abstract: Rights-based management is prevalent in today's developed-world fisheries, yet spatiotemporal models of fishing behavior do not reflect such institutional settings. We develop a model of spatiotemporal fishing behavior that incorporates the dynamic and general equilibrium elements of catch-share fisheries. We propose an estimation strategy that is able to recover structural behavioral parameters through a nested fixed-point maximum likelihood procedure. We illustrate our modeling approach through a Monte Carlo analysis and demonstrate its importance for predicting out-of-sample counterfactual policies.
abstract_zh: 权利基础型管理在当今发达国家的渔业中十分普遍，然而捕鱼行为的时空模型并未反映这种制度环境。我们构建了一个包含渔获份额渔业动态和一般均衡要素的时空捕鱼行为模型。我们提出了一种估计策略，能够通过嵌套不动点极大似然程序恢复结构性行为参数。我们通过蒙特卡洛分析展示了该建模方法，并论证了其在预测样本外反事实政策方面的重要性。

title: Taking a Moment to Measure Networks - An Approach to Species Conservation
The Distributional Outcomes of Rights-Based Management in Fisheries
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Rights-based management reforms in fisheries have attracted controversy regarding the unequal distribution of their economic benefits, but systematic quantitative evidence has been lacking due to data limitations. Our research leverages a longitudinal dataset to compare payments to captains, crew, vessel owners, and owners of harvest quota in the Bering Sea crab fisheries both before and after implementing individual transferable quotas (ITQs). This paper provides a fishery-wide accounting of returns to these diverse stakeholder groups at the vessel level. The results underscore the importance of considering the distribution of payments to different stakeholders within each vessel as well as heterogeneity in payments across vessels. Our approach provides a model for collecting and analyzing data on distributional outcomes for other fisheries.
abstract_zh: 渔业中的权利基础型管理改革因其经济收益分配不平等而引发争议，但由于数据限制，系统性的定量证据一直缺乏。我们的研究利用纵向数据集，比较了实施个人可转让配额（ITQ）前后白令海蟹类渔业中船长、船员、船东和配额持有者的收入。本文从船只层面对这些不同利益相关方的收益进行了全渔业范围的核算。结果强调了在每艘船内部考虑不同利益相关方的支付分配，以及跨船只支付异质性的重要性。我们的方法为收集和分析其他渔业收入分配结果的数据提供了一个范式。

title: The Future of Fishing for Fun: The Economics and Sustainable Management of Recreational Fisheries
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: The management of recreational fisheries has received relatively little research attention from economists. Nevertheless, recreational fisheries generate substantial economic benefits and ecological impacts in many freshwater and marine systems, although they frequently face a range of management challenges. In this article we consider the endogenous feedbacks and exogenous stressors within the coupled human-natural system of recreational fisheries that threaten their efficient and sustainable management, and we review the potential role of economics in addressing these challenges. We discuss key similarities and differences between commercial and recreational fisheries and the implications of the differences for the theory and practice of managing recreational fisheries. Finally, we identify important research gaps that must be addressed to enable policy makers to more accurately weigh the costs and benefits of changes to recreational fishery policies.
abstract_zh: 经济学家对休闲渔业管理的研究关注相对较少。然而，休闲渔业在许多淡水和海洋系统中产生了可观的经济效益和生态影响，尽管其往往面临一系列管理挑战。在本文中，我们考虑休闲渔业这一人与自然耦合系统中的内生反馈和外生压力因素，这些因素威胁着其高效和可持续的管理，并探讨经济学在应对这些挑战中的潜在作用。我们讨论了商业渔业与休闲渔业之间的主要异同，以及这些差异对休闲渔业管理理论与实践的启示。最后，我们指出了必须加以解决的重要研究空白，以使政策制定者能够更准确地权衡休闲渔业政策变动的成本与收益。

title: Understanding the role of institutional diversity on irrigation system dynamics
Embedding Farmers' Groundwater Use in the Context of their Livelihoods: Farmers' Perspectives on Social-Ecological Stressors, Causes, and Solutions
venue: International Journal of Sustainable Development and World Ecology
abstract: Achieving the Sustainable Development Goals in the agriculture and water sectors requires actors (e.g. farmers, water authorities, scientists) to consider the sustainability of both human and water elements. With a focus on farmers, using a behavioral approach, we explore how the groundwater system, which consists of human and water elements, is seen by pistachio growers in Rafsanjan, Iran (a major pistachio-production region in the world). We advocate that farmers’ rationales behind their decisions about their groundwater use – including their reactions to policies implemented to conserve groundwater– often can be understood in terms of their understanding and knowledge of the groundwater system in which they are embedded. To this end, we explore how pistachio growers see (1) their groundwater-dependent livelihoods (Livelihood); (2) the stressors that threaten their livelihoods (Stressor); and (3) their responses to those stressors (Response). In addition, we document some differences between pistachio growers’ knowledge of the groundwater system and those of scientists. We find that, while showing heterogenous views, the majority of pistachio growers’ perceptions and subjective norms on the Livelihood, Stressor, and Response components strongly favor the human element (short-term pistachio production) over the water element (groundwater conservation for future use). Furthermore, we find that pistachio growers’ knowledge of the groundwater system is an additional factor that influences their decisions to increase groundwater use. We discuss the implications of the results for conserving groundwater resources and maintaining pistachio growers’ livelihoods.
abstract_zh: 要在农业和水资源部门实现可持续发展目标，需要各行为主体（如农民、水务机构、科学家）同时考虑人类和水资源两方面要素的可持续性。我们以农民为焦点，采用行为学方法，探究伊朗拉夫桑的开心果种植者如何看待由人类和水资源要素构成的地下水系统（拉夫桑是世界主要的开心果产区）。我们认为，农民在地下水使用决策中的理由，包括他们对旨在保护地下水的政策的反应，往往可以从其所嵌入的地下水系统的认知和知识角度加以理解。为此，我们探究开心果种植者如何看待：(1) 依赖地下水的生计（生计）；(2) 威胁其生计的压力因素（压力）；以及 (3) 他们对这些压力的应对（应对）。此外，我们还记录了开心果种植者与科学家在地下水系统知识上的一些差异。我们发现，尽管观点存在异质性，但大多数开心果种植者在生计、压力和应对三个组成部分上的认知与主观规范，都明显倾向于人类要素（短期开心果生产）而非水资源要素（为未来利用而保护地下水）。此外，我们发现开心果种植者对地下水系统的认知，是影响其增加地下水使用决策的另一因素。我们讨论了研究结果对保护地下水资源和维持开心果种植者生计的启示。

title: Feeding the Dragon: The Evolution of China's Fishery Imports
How Smart are Water Smart Landscapes?
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Understanding the effectiveness of alternative approaches to water conservation is imperative for ensuring the security and reliability of water services for urban residents. We analyze data from one of the longest-running “cash for grass” policies – the Southern Nevada Water Authority's Water Smart Landscapes program – where homeowners are paid to replace grass with desert landscaping. We use a sixteen year long panel dataset of monthly water consumption records for 300,000 homes in Las Vegas, Nevada. We estimate the average water savings per square meter of turf removed with an event study and a panel difference-in-differences approach. We find that participation in this program reduced the average treated home's consumption by 20 percent. We find no evidence that water savings degrade as the landscape ages. Depending on the assumed time horizon of benefits from turf removal, we find that the Water Smart Landscapes program cost the water authority about $1.88 per thousand gallons of water saved, which compares favorably to alternative means of water conservation or supply augmentation.
abstract_zh: 了解各种节水方式的有效性，对于保障城市居民用水服务的安全性和可靠性至关重要。我们分析了历史最悠久的“以钱换草”政策之一的数据——南内华达水务局的“智慧水景观”（Water Smart Landscapes）计划，在该计划中，房主可获得补贴，将草坪替换为沙漠景观。我们使用了内华达州拉斯维加斯30万户家庭长达16年的月度用水记录面板数据集。我们通过事件研究法和面板双重差分方法，估计了每移除一平方米草坪所带来的平均节水量。我们发现，参与该计划使参与家庭的平均用水量降低了20%。我们没有发现节水效果随景观老化而衰减的证据。根据对草坪移除效益时间跨度的不同假设，我们发现“智慧水景观”计划使水务局每节约一千加仑水的成本约为1.88美元，与其他节水或增加供水的替代方式相比，这一成本具有优势。

title: Per-Tip Changes to the Economic Value of Ontario, Canada Anglers Fishing the Laurentian Great Lakes under Target Species Transitions
The Influence of Human Population Change and Aquatic Invasive Species Establishment on Future Recreational Fishing Activities to the Canadian Portion of the Laurentian Great Lakes
venue: Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Science

title: Exploring Farmers' Perceptions about their Depleting Groundwater Resources using Path Analysis: Implications for Groundwater Overdraft and Income Diversification
Fishing to Live or Living to Fish: Job Satisfaction and Identity of West Coast Fishermen
abstract: Fishing is a dangerous and financially risky way to make a living, but it attracts many participants that prefer it to higher paying and safer jobs. Based on a survey of over 1400 U.S. West Coast fishing vessel owners we use factor analysis and structural equation modeling to quantify distinct latent variables representing job satisfaction related to non-monetary versus monetary aspects of fishing and measures of identity and social capital associated with being a fisher. We show that these latent variables have distinct effects on (stated) fishery participation behavior and that higher non-monetary job satisfaction, social capital, and identity, are associated with a willingness to forgo higher income to be a fisher. Understanding how these factors affect and are affected by participation in fisheries could be important to increase benefits from fisheries and to ensure sustainability of management regimes that rely on indirect controls on effort to limit catch.
abstract_zh: 捕鱼是一种危险且经济上风险较高的谋生方式，但仍吸引了许多宁愿选择它、而非收入更高、更安全工作的人。基于对超过1400名美国西海岸渔船船东的调查，我们运用因子分析和结构方程模型，量化了代表与捕鱼相关的非货币性与货币性工作满意度、以及作为渔民的身份认同和社会资本的潜在变量。我们发现，这些潜在变量对（陈述的）渔业参与行为具有不同的影响，并且较高的非货币性工作满意度、社会资本和身份认同，与愿意放弃更高收入而从事捕鱼的意愿相关。理解这些因素如何影响渔业参与并受其影响，对于提高渔业收益、确保依赖间接投入控制来限制渔获量的管理制度的可持续性，可能十分重要。

title: How do Resource Mobility and Group Size Affect Institutional Arrangements for Rule Enforcement? Empirical Hypotheses about Institutional Fit
Intertemporal Substitution in Travel-Cost Models with Seasonal Time Constraints
Sustaining Coupled Irrigation Infrastructures: Multiple Instruments for Multiple Dilemmas
Decoupling the Value of Leisure Time from Labor Market Returns in Travel Cost Models
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists

title: Opinion: Governing the recreational dimension of global fisheries
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

title: Reducing Marine Plastic Pollution: Policy Insights from Economics
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Marine plastic pollution is heavily driven by escaped plastic waste from land. Effectively reducing flows of plastic pollution into the oceans requires incentivizing efficient disposal decisions, discouraging production and consumption of products with low recyclability and reuse potential, and encouraging lower-impact, easily recyclable product and packaging designs. We examine the economic literature on waste management and integrated environmental policy to assess how particular policies target these individual pathways and can efficiently reduce flows of plastics into waterways. These policies include production/retail bans and standards, extended producer responsibility, price-based policies such as advance disposal fees and two-part instruments, and interventions grounded in behavioral economics and psychology. We also consider the applicability of these policies in coastal developing nations that often rely upon the informal sector for waste management services. We conclude by identifying important issues for future research.
abstract_zh: 海洋塑料污染主要由陆地上流失的废弃塑料所驱动。要有效减少流入海洋的塑料污染，需要激励高效的处置决策，抑制低可回收性、低可再利用性产品的生产和消费，并鼓励影响较小、易于回收的产品与包装设计。我们考察了关于废物管理和综合环境政策的经济学文献，以评估各类特定政策如何针对这些不同路径，并有效减少流入水道的塑料。这些政策包括生产或零售禁令与标准、生产者责任延伸制度、基于价格的政策（如预付处置费和两部制工具），以及基于行为经济学和心理学的干预措施。我们还考虑了这些政策在沿海发展中国家的适用性，这些国家通常依赖非正规部门提供废物管理服务。最后，我们指出了未来研究的重要问题。

title: Flame Retardant Contamination and Seafood Sustainability
abstract: A growing body of evidence for chemical contamination in seafood has raised concerns about the safety of seafood consumption. Available data also indicate that some fishery stocks that are overharvested are also the most laden with certain contaminants. Flame retardant chemicals, used in textiles, plastics, and other products are a class of these seafood contaminants that are particularly concerning as they are linked to cancer and endocrine disruption. To investigate the potentially useful relationship between fishery sustainability and flame retardant concentration in seafood, we used polybrominated diphenyl ethers (PBDEs) as a case study to assess how fishery status and species vulnerability coincide with levels of brominated flame retardants found in the tissue of popularly consumed fish. While none of our metrics of sustainability showed strong relationships to PBDE contamination rates, our results suggest that the same intrinsic biological and ecological traits, which facilitate the uptake of chemicals, also contribute to how species respond to fishing pressures. Given the dual challenges of ensuring seafood sustainability and protecting human health, we then explored the implications of bundling the public good of conservation with the private good of health.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的证据表明海产品存在化学污染，这引发了人们对食用海产品安全性的担忧。现有数据还表明，一些被过度捕捞的渔业种群恰恰也是某些污染物含量最高的种群。阻燃化学品广泛用于纺织品、塑料及其他产品中，是这类海产品污染物中尤为令人担忧的一类，因为它们与癌症和内分泌干扰有关。为探究渔业可持续性与海产品中阻燃剂浓度之间潜在的有用关系，我们以多溴二苯醚（PBDEs）为案例，评估渔业状况和物种脆弱性如何与常见食用鱼类组织中溴系阻燃剂的含量相吻合。尽管我们所使用的可持续性指标均未显示出与PBDE污染率之间的强关系，但我们的结果表明，那些促进化学物质吸收的内在生物和生态特征，同样也影响着物种对捕捞压力的反应。鉴于确保海产品可持续性与保护人类健康所面临的双重挑战，我们随后探讨了将保护公共物品与健康私人物品捆绑起来的启示。

title: Status-quo management of marine recreational fisheries undermines angler welfare
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Marine recreational fisheries are culturally and economically important around the world. However, they often suffer from management that promotes short seasons, congestion, wasteful allocations of fish, and overfishing. We use survey data from anglers taking trips on for-hire vessels in the US Gulf of Mexico to estimate the magnitude of economic benefits squandered by current management. We find a minimum of $139/y of benefits per angler could be realized under appropriate management reforms. These rights-based approaches would improve angler benefits by increasing flexibility to fish year round—improving access while establishing greater accountability for fish harvest. Extending similar reforms worldwide could generate billions of dollars of benefits to anglers and related sectors.
abstract_zh: 海洋休闲渔业在世界范围内具有重要的文化和经济意义。然而，这类渔业常常受到管理不善的困扰，表现为捕捞季节过短、拥挤、鱼类分配浪费以及过度捕捞。我们利用美国墨西哥湾商业载客渔船上垂钓者的调查数据，估算了当前管理方式所浪费的经济效益规模。我们发现，在适当的管理改革下，每位垂钓者每年至少可以实现139美元的收益。这些权利基础型的方法将通过增加全年捕鱼的灵活性来改善垂钓者的收益，在改善渔业准入的同时，也增强了对鱼类捕捞的问责。若在全球范围内推广类似改革，可为垂钓者及相关行业带来数十亿美元的收益。

title: The Nature of Capital and Ecosystem Income
Ecosystem Based Management and the Wealth of Ecosystems
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Ecosystems store vast quantities of wealth, but difficulties measuring wealth held in ecosystems prevent its inclusion in accounting systems. Ecosystem-based management endeavors to manage ecosystems holistically. However, ecosystem-based management lacks headline indicators to evaluate performance. We unify the inclusive wealth and ecosystem-based management paradigms, allowing apples-to-apples comparisons between the wealth of the ecosystem and other forms of wealth, while providing a headline performance index for evaluating the performance of ecosystem-based management. We project that the Baltic Sea fishery ecosystem yields increasing stores of wealth over the next 50 y under the ecosystem-based management-inspired multispecies maximum sustainable yield management beginning in 2017, whereas the previous single-species management generally results in declining wealth.
abstract_zh: 基于生态系统的管理与生态系统财富。生态系统蕴藏着巨大的财富，但测量生态系统中所蕴藏财富的困难，使其无法纳入核算体系。基于生态系统的管理致力于整体性地管理生态系统。然而，基于生态系统的管理缺乏用于评估绩效的总体指标。我们将包容性财富与基于生态系统的管理范式统一起来，使生态系统财富与其他形式的财富之间能够进行可比较的对照，同时提供了一个用于评估基于生态系统管理绩效的总体绩效指数。我们预测，在2017年开始实施的、受基于生态系统管理启发的多物种最大可持续产量管理之下，波罗的海渔业生态系统在未来50年内将产生不断增加的财富存量；而此前的单物种管理总体上会导致财富下降。

title: Empirical Models of the Fishery Production Process: Conflating Technology with Incentives?
Growing into Water Conservation? Decomposing the Drivers of Reduced Water Consumption in Las Vegas, NV
abstract: Increasing population and drought have lead to growing concerns about water scarcity across the US despite a long decline in per-capita consumption. To what extent is this decline the result of water policy vs. other exogenous changes? Many municipalities implement multiple water-focused policies simultaneously – while still subject to other exogenous drivers – so it is important to pair policy evaluations with approaches that examine multiple drivers of water use. The importance of water policy, infrastructure change, and broader technological and demographic trends in influencing water demand has not been measured. We demonstrate a novel method for decomposing multiple drivers of consumption using a dataset of neighborhood water consumption, home infrastructure characteristics, and vegetation in Las Vegas. The largest measureable factor driving conservation for Las Vegas as a whole is lower consumption from new homes, while in established neighborhoods it is declining vegetation area. However, factors we measure directly account for only half of the observed consumption decline. This provides indirect evidence that consumption declines coincident with a drought alert, increased water waste enforcement, and other policy responses also played an important role in conservation. An array of approaches directed at both infrastructure and behavior can effectively reduce consumption.
abstract_zh: 人口增长和干旱导致美国各地对水资源短缺的担忧日益加剧，尽管人均用水量已长期下降。这种下降在多大程度上是水政策作用的结果，又在多大程度上源于其他外生变化？许多城市同时实施多项以水为核心的政策，同时仍受其他外生因素的影响，因此，将政策评估与能够考察多种用水驱动因素的方法相结合十分重要。水政策、基础设施变化以及更广泛的技术和人口趋势对用水需求的影响尚未得到衡量。我们展示了一种新方法，利用拉斯维加斯社区用水量、住房基础设施特征和植被的数据集，对多种消费驱动因素进行分解。对拉斯维加斯整体而言，推动节水的最大可测因素是新建住房的用水量较低；而在成熟社区，则是植被面积的减少。然而，我们直接测量的因素只能解释观测到的用水量下降的一半。这为以下观点提供了间接证据：与干旱预警、加强的浪费用水执法及其他政策应对相伴随的用水量下降，也在节水中发挥了重要作用。针对基础设施和行为两方面的一系列举措，均可有效减少用水量。

title: Thinking Beyond the Moratorium: Testing the Feasibility of a Hypothetical Whaling-Conservation Permit Market in Norway
Measuring the Value of Groundwater and other Forms of Natural Capital
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Economists have long argued, with recent acceptance from the science and policy community, that natural resources are capital assets. Pricing of natural capital has remained elusive, with the result that its value is often ignored, and expenditures on conservation are treated as costs rather than investments. This neglect stems from a lack of a valuation framework to enable apples to apples comparisons with traditional forms of capital. We develop such an approach and demonstrate it on Kansas’ groundwater stock. Between 1996 and 2005, groundwater withdrawal reduced Kansas’ wealth approximately $110 million per year. Wealth lost through groundwater depletion in Kansas is large, but in a range where offsetting investments may be feasible.
abstract_zh: 测量地下水及其他形式自然资本的价值。经济学家长期以来主张，自然资源是资本资产，科学界和政策界近来也已接受这一观点。然而，自然资本的定价仍然难以实现，其结果是其价值常被忽视，而对保护的支出被视为成本而非投资。这种忽视源于缺乏一个能够与传统资本形式进行同类可比较的估值框架。我们发展了这样一种方法，并以堪萨斯州的地下水存量为例加以说明。1996至2005年间，地下水抽取使堪萨斯州的财富每年减少约1.1亿美元。通过地下水枯竭造成的财富损失在堪萨斯州规模很大，但仍处于可能通过抵消性投资加以弥补的范围之内。

title: Wealth Reallocation and Sustainability Under Climate Change

Associations between Food Environment around Schools and Professionally Measured Weight Status for Middle and High School Students
abstract: BACKGROUND: Obesity rates among school-age children remain high. Access to energy-dense foods at home, in schools, in stores, and restaurants around homes and schools is of concern. Research on the relationship between food environment around schools and students' weight status is inconclusive. This study examines the association between weight status of middle and high school students and proximity to a comprehensive set of food outlets around schools. METHODS: Deidentified nurse-measured heights and weights data were obtained for 12,954 middle and high school students attending 33 public schools in four low-income communities in New Jersey. Geocoded locations of supermarkets, convenience stores, small grocery stores, and limited-service restaurants were obtained from commercial sources. Random-effect regression models with robust standard errors were developed to adjust for unequal variances across schools and clustering of students within schools. RESULTS: Proximity to small grocery stores that offered some healthy options (e.g., five fruits, five vegetables, and low-fat/skim milk) and supermarkets was associated with healthier student weight status. Having a small grocery store within 0.25 mile of school and an additional such store within that radius was associated with a lower BMI z-score (p<0.05). An additional supermarket within 0.25 mile of schools was associated with a lower probability of being overweight/obese (p<0.05). CONCLUSIONS: Improving access to healthy food outlets, such as small stores, that offer healthy food options and supermarkets around middle and high schools is a potential strategy for improving weight outcomes among students.
abstract_zh: 背景：学龄儿童的肥胖率仍然居高不下。家庭、学校、商店及餐馆周边容易获得高能量食品，令人担忧。关于学校周边食品环境与学生体重状况之间关系的研究尚无定论。本研究考察了初中和高中学生的体重状况与其学校周边一套完整食品销售网点的距离之间的关系。方法：我们获取了新泽西州四个低收入社区33所公立学校中12954名初中和高中学生经护士测量的身高和体重去识别化数据。超市、便利店、小型杂货店和有限服务餐厅的地理编码位置来自商业数据源。我们建立了带有稳健标准误的随机效应回归模型，以调整各学校间方差不等以及学生在学校内聚类的问题。结果：与小型杂货店（提供一些健康选择，如五种水果、五种蔬菜及低脂或脱脂牛奶）和超市的距离越近，学生体重状况越健康。学校0.25英里范围内有一家小型杂货店，且该半径内另有一家此类商店，与较低的BMI z评分相关（p<0.05）。学校0.25英里范围内每多一家超市，与超重/肥胖概率较低相关（p<0.05）。结论：改善中学和高中周边提供健康食品选择的网点（如小型商店）及超市的可及性，是改善学生体重状况的一项潜在策略。

title: What are we Protecting? Fisher Behavior and the Unintended Consequences of Spatial Closures as a Fishery Management Tool
abstract: Spatial closures like marine protected areas (MPAs) are prominent tools for ecosystem‐based management in fisheries. However, the adaptive behavior of fishermen, the apex predator in the ecosystem, to MPAs may upset the balance of fishing impacts across species. While ecosystem‐based management (EBM) emphasizes the protection of all species in the environment, the weakest stock often dominates management attention. We use data before and after the implementation of large spatial closures in a North Pacific trawl fishery to show how closures designed for red king crab protection spurred dramatic increases in Pacific halibut bycatch due to both direct displacement effects and indirect effects from adaptations in fishermen's targeting behavior. We identify aspects of the ecological and economic context of the fishery that contributed to these surprising behaviors, noting that many multispecies fisheries are likely to share these features. Our results highlight the need either to anticipate the behavioral adaptations of fishermen across multiple species in reserve design, a form of implementation error, or to design management systems that are robust to these adaptations. Failure to do so may yield patterns of fishing effort and mortality that undermine the broader objectives of multispecies management and potentially alter ecosystems in profound ways.
abstract_zh: 海洋保护区（MPAs）等空间禁渔措施是渔业生态系统管理中的重要工具。然而，作为生态系统中顶级捕食者的渔民，其对海洋保护区的适应性行为可能会打破各物种之间捕捞影响的平衡。尽管基于生态系统的管理（EBM）强调保护环境中的所有物种，但最脆弱的种群往往占据管理关注的主导地位。我们利用北太平洋拖网渔业中大规模空间禁渔措施实施前后的数据，展示了为保护帝王蟹而设计的禁渔区，如何因直接的转移效应以及渔民捕捞目标调整所带来的间接效应，导致太平洋大比目鱼兼捕量急剧上升。我们确定了该渔业生态和经济环境中促成这些令人意外行为的若干方面，并指出许多多鱼种渔业很可能具有这些特征。我们的结果凸显了两方面的必要性：要么在保护区设计中预见渔民跨多个物种的适应性行为（这是一种执行误差），要么设计对这些适应性行为具有稳健性的管理体系。若做不到这一点，可能导致捕捞努力量和死亡率的格局偏离多鱼种管理的更广泛目标，并可能以深远方式改变生态系统。

title: Employment and Remuneration Effects of IFQs in the Bering Sea/Aleutian Islands Crab Fisheries
abstract: This article utilizes a census of vessels before and after implementation of catch shares in the Bering Sea/Aleutian Island (BSAI) crab fisheries to examine the short-run effects of catch shares on employment and remuneration of crew. The number of individuals employed declined proportionately to the exit of vessels following implementation. Total crew hours dedicated to fishing activities remained roughly constant, while employment in redundant pre- and post-season activities declined due to the consolidation of quota on fewer vessels. We find little evidence of substantial changes in the share contracts used to compensate fishermen. Finally, we explore a wide array of remuneration measures for crew and conclude that both seasonal and daily employment remuneration increased substantially for many crew in the post-rationalization fishery, while remuneration per unit of landings declined as a result of a combination of increased crew productivity and the necessity of paying for fishing quota in the new system.
abstract_zh: 本文利用白令海与阿留申群岛（BSAI）蟹类渔业实施渔获份额制度前后的船只普查数据，考察渔获份额制度对船员就业和报酬的短期影响。随着船只退出，就业人数成比例下降。由于配额集中到更少的船只上，用于实际捕捞活动的船员总工时基本保持不变，而季前和季后冗余活动中的就业则有所减少。我们发现，用于补偿渔民的分成合同几乎没有发生实质性变化。最后，我们探讨了一系列船员报酬指标，并得出结论：在改革后的渔业中，许多船员的季节性和日均就业报酬均大幅增加，但每单位渔获量的报酬却因船员生产率提高和新制度下必须为渔业配额付费这两方面的共同作用而下降。
